description: This file defines a Java interface 'DigitalProductService' within a shopping platform's core business module. It specifies methods for managing digital products, including saving, updating, associating products with digital files, and retrieval based on store and product identifiers.

classes.name: DigitalProductService
classes.description: An interface extending generic service functionality for managing digital products, including methods to save, update, add files, and retrieve digital product information.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new digital product or updates an existing one.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Associates a digital file with a product, given input content.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a digital product associated with a specific store and product.
